title: SaaS webhook event catalog — row schema (v0)
description: One row per (vendor, event_name) pair. Fields below describe a single webhook event emitted by a SaaS product, intended for ingestion into HuggingFace datasets and rendering on the automatelab.tech/webhooks/ companion site. Schema-only, no payload bodies redistributed.

vendor.description: Kebab-case vendor slug. Stable identifier used in URLs (e.g. /webhooks/<vendor>/) and as a join key for any downstream consumer. Must match vendors.yaml.slug.

vendor_display_name.description: Human-readable vendor name with original casing (e.g. 'GitHub', 'Microsoft Teams').

category.description: High-level grouping for companion site index facets. Closed enum so the facet UI is bounded; extension requires deliberate dataset version bump.

event_name.description: Canonical event identifier as emitted by the vendor (e.g. 'invoice.payment_succeeded', 'pull_request.opened'). Exactly as the vendor uses it — do not normalize casing or punctuation, that's the value developers will be searching for.

event_namespace.description: Optional namespace or resource grouping if the vendor uses one (e.g. for Slack the namespace might be 'events_api'). Null when the vendor has a single flat event space.

trigger_description.description: Short, factual summary of what triggers this event. Facts only — paraphrased from docs, never copied. Max 500 chars to stay clearly in fair-use facts territory and to keep companion-site cards compact.

payload_schema.description: JSON Schema (Draft 2020-12) describing the event payload shape. Field names + types + descriptions only. No example values, no vendor marketing copy. If the vendor publishes their own JSON Schema or OpenAPI fragment, normalize it into Draft 2020-12 here.

required_oauth_scopes.description: OAuth scopes the receiving app must hold to receive this event. Null if vendor uses API keys (no scopes) or scopes are not documented per-event.

required_subscription_event.description: Some vendors require subscribing to a parent event identifier that differs from the event_name (e.g. HubSpot 'contact.creation' subscription emits a specific event shape). Null when subscription identifier equals event_name.

auth_method.description: How the vendor authenticates the webhook delivery. Closed enum covers the common shapes; rarer methods go in `signature_algorithm_detail` with auth_method='other'.

signature_header.description: HTTP header name carrying the signature or auth token (e.g. 'Stripe-Signature', 'X-Hub-Signature-256'). Null when auth_method is 'none' or signature is sent in body.

signature_algorithm_detail.description: Free-text detail when the auth_method enum is insufficient (e.g. for 'other', or to note 'HMAC of timestamp.body concatenated', or non-standard key derivation).

backoff.description: Free-text description of backoff policy as documented (e.g. 'exponential, capped at 24h').

total_retry_window.description: ISO 8601 duration or natural-language description (e.g. 'PT72H', '3 days').

retry_policy.description: Structured retry behavior per vendor docs. Null when vendor does not document retries.

max_payload_size_bytes.description: Documented maximum payload size, if vendor publishes one.

idempotency_key_header.description: Header name carrying the per-delivery idempotency key, if vendor provides one (e.g. Stripe 'Stripe-Signature' timestamp, GitHub 'X-GitHub-Delivery').

event_id_header.description: Header name carrying a per-delivery unique event ID (overlaps with idempotency_key_header for some vendors; both kept since vendors differ on naming intent).

delivery_guarantees.description: Delivery semantics as documented by the vendor.

delivery.description: Transport mechanism by which the event reaches the consumer. 'webhook' (HTTP POST callback) is the default and may be left null; explicitly tag for vendors that mix delivery mechanisms (Discord emits Gateway events over websocket and interaction webhooks over HTTP; tagging required per the 2026-05-13 ToS audit compliance obligation).

docs_url.description: Canonical URL to the vendor docs page that describes this event. Must be public, no auth wall.

last_introspected_at.description: UTC timestamp of the last successful extraction of this row. Used by the monthly auto-update to surface stale rows.

source_extractor_version.description: Version of the per-vendor extractor that produced this row. Lets downstream consumers correlate row quality with extractor improvements.

extraction_method.description: How this row was produced. 'manual-*' = tier-1 bespoke extractor; 'llm-assisted' = tier-2; the vendor-* methods cover cases where the vendor publishes a machine-readable schema we can canonicalize.

extraction_confidence.description: Self-reported confidence for LLM-assisted rows (0.0 - 1.0). Manual rows leave this null. Quality audit (sub 1.8) thresholds on this field.

notes.description: Free-text caveats: known schema drift, deprecation status, beta-flag visibility, etc.
